items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: It was a Bert Williams (inaudible). ... Yeah - 'Save a Little Dram For Me.'

ctx.x: Well, about the time we went to Cincinnati - he was offered a job and we went to Cincinnati. He was offered a job in Cincinnati and this is the first time, of course, I had ever seen a big city. And, so, I did a little song at that time - it was called, "Save Your---

Yeah - "Save a Little Dram For Me." And, I used to do a drunken act on that. And, I would pretend I was drinking out of a bottle and as I did this little preaching bit, I got drunker and drunker which was my big comedy number. And, all that stuff. So, we went to Cincinnati and, uh, gosh, we were--- that summer,
